# Looking for a Bevel alternative?

Bevel is a connected health coach — wearables plus bloodwork plus AI guidance, served from the cloud. Observa is the deliberate opposite: a translation layer for the Apple Health data you already have, with every correlation computed and stored on your own device. Less breadth, more privacy.

See Observa Compare

## How does Observa compare to Bevel?

These apps make opposite trade-offs. Choose by which trade matches what you actually want.

Scope

Observa: Apple Health and Apple Watch data only — HRV, ECG, sleep stages, RHR, workouts, active energy.  
  
Bevel: Wearables, bloodwork integrations, health records, lifestyle journaling — a much broader graph routed through their AI coach. [...] ## FAQ

What is the best Bevel alternative?

If you want plain-English Apple Health interpretation without a cloud coach, Observa is the closest match. It reads Apple Health and Apple Watch data and surfaces named correlations against a 60-day personal baseline — everything on-device, no account, no servers.

 Is Observa a connected health coach like Bevel?

No — and that's deliberate. Bevel pairs wearables, bloodwork, and lifestyle data with an AI coach in the cloud. Observa is a translation layer for the Apple Health data you already have, with every computation staying on your device.

 Is Observa cheaper than Bevel? [...] ## When to pick Observa over Bevel

 You don't want your health data sitting on someone else's servers — even if they pinky-promise security
 You don't have bloodwork or extensive lab data to feed a coach, and Apple Health is your primary signal
 You want sentences explaining specific correlations, not AI-coach paragraphs
 You'd rather pay $49.99 once than subscribe to a coach indefinitely
 "No account required" is a feature, not a friction

## When to keep Bevel instead

 You want a true connected coach that integrates bloodwork, lab data, and wearables
 You prefer conversational AI Q&A over plain-English insight cards
 You value the biological-age and integrated lifestyle dashboards Bevel pioneered

results.content:
Google Health is a strong Bevel alternative for Android users, especially those with a Fitbit or Pixel Watch. It combines activity, sleep and health tracking with optional Gemini-powered coaching.

Welltory is better suited to people who primarily want HRV, stress and energy insights.

Neura is a stronger choice when the goal is to connect data from different wearables, fitness platforms and lifestyle sources.

WHOOP, Oura and Ultrahuman also work with Android, but each requires dedicated hardware. They make more sense for users who want to change their wearable as well as their health app. [...] Athlytic feels more focused than Bevel. It concentrates on recovery, cardiovascular exertion, sleep and workout analysis rather than attempting to cover every part of health. It also processes health information on the user’s device, which may appeal to people who are particularly concerned about cloud storage.

The app offers a seven-day trial and costs approximately $30 per year. However, it is not an Android alternative. Athlytic is built around iPhone, Apple Watch and Apple Health.

Choose Athlytic if you want detailed Apple Watch recovery and workout analysis in a more focused interface.

Stay with Bevel if you also want free nutrition tracking, Strength Builder, journaling, cycle tracking or a broader collection of health dashboards. [...] However, Bevel is not the right choice for everyone. There is still no native Bevel app for Android, and some people prefer a simpler recovery dashboard, a dedicated wearable or a coaching platform that connects more areas of their health.

The best Bevel alternative depends on what you want to replace. Athlytic is the closest alternative for Apple Watch recovery tracking, Google Health is the strongest option for Android and Fitbit users, and Neura is better suited to people who want to connect data from multiple health sources and turn it into adaptive plans. WHOOP, Oura and Ultrahuman are worth considering if you are willing to invest in dedicated hardware.

Short verdict: Pick Athlytic if you want the same Watch and a tighter training loop. Pick Fitcoin if you want Recovery plus gym scoring and rewards, including Android. Pick Whoop if a strap was always the real product. Apple Sleep Score is enough if you never needed Strain at all.

Disclosure: Fitcoin is our product. We are not affiliated with Apple, Garmin, Whoop, Bevel, Athlytic, HRV4Training or the other apps named here. Where Fitcoin appears, it is as a Sleep, Recovery and Energy companion that also scores workouts for partner rewards, not a PayPal cash-out app. Scores described below are wellness estimates for general fitness. They are not medical devices and they do not diagnose illness.

## Why people actually look for Bevel alternatives [...] ## 3. Fitcoin: Recovery with a job after training

Fitcoin gives you SleepScore, Recovery, Energy, Immune Shield and Load context, then FitScore for the session and partner rewards. It runs on iPhone and Android via Health Connect, with optional Whoop or Oura data when you connect them (you do not have to). This is the honest alternative if the reason you installed Bevel was to make the Watch useful, and you also wanted walking and gym to count for something other than a chart.

It is a weaker match if you wanted Bevel’s nutrition score and biological age. Fitcoin is Recovery, Energy, SleepScore and FitScore rewards, not a food OS.
